recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片圈起的大型異常淋巴細胞核膜摺疊呈腦迴狀（cerebriform）、有核仁與中等量藍色細胞質；B–E 圖切片中間質性大細胞群 CD3+、CD4+ 且 CD7 缺失，配合蕈狀肉芽腫病史，代表骨髓侵犯。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells (circled) with deeply folded, convoluted (cerebriform) nuclear contours
Finely granular to vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli; moderate amount of pale-to-medium blue agranular cytoplasm
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells in the aspirate
Core biopsy (H&E) with interstitial clusters of large cells with irregular nuclei
IHC: large cells CD3+ and CD4+ (membranous) with loss of CD7 (only scattered background positivity)
describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate smear (A) contains a population of large atypical lymphoid cells with convoluted, folded (cerebriform) nuclei, fine chromatin, distinct nucleoli, and a moderate amount of agranular cytoplasm, admixed with maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. The core biopsy (B) shows interstitial aggregates of large cells with irregular nuclei in a hypercellular marrow. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells are positive for CD3 (C) and CD4 (D) and show loss of CD7 (E). In a patient with known mycosis fungoides, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by mycosis fungoides with large-cell transformation.

ddx.vs: Sézary syndrome shares CD4+/CD7- cerebriform cells but is defined by erythroderma and a leukemic clone in blood (≥1000/µL Sézary cells or CD4:CD8 ≥10), rather than preceding patch/plaque MF with large-cell transformation.
ATLL cells are CD4+/CD7- but show polylobated 'flower' nuclei, CD25 expression, and HTLV-1 serology positivity.
PTCL NOS may be immunophenotypically similar, so separation depends on clinical history of MF and matching TCR clonality between skin and marrow.
Monocytic cells also have folded nuclei but contain fine azurophilic granules and express CD14/CD68/lysozyme rather than CD3.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD3, CD4, CD7
